# Graph Cards

2020 ICPC Asia Taipei-Hsinchu Regional
Problem G
Graph Cards
Time limit: 30 seconds
Memory limit: 1024 megabytes
Problem Description
A deck of graph cards is placed on the table. Each graph card 𝜒 is decorated with an undirected
simple graph 𝐺𝜒 so that 𝐺𝜒 is connected and 𝐺𝜒 has the same number of nodes and edges.
Note that different graph cards may have different numbers of nodes. An example is depicted
as follows.
We say two graph cards are identical if and only if the graphs associated with them, say
𝐺1 = (𝑉1, 𝐸1) and 𝐺2 = (𝑉2, 𝐸2), are isomorphism; that is, there exists a bijection 𝑓 between
the node sets 𝑉1 and 𝑉2 so that for every 𝑥, 𝑦 ∈ 𝑉1, edge (𝑥, 𝑦) ∈ 𝐸1 if and only if edge
(𝑓(𝑥), 𝑓(𝑦)) ∈ 𝐸2. Our goal is to compute the number of distinct graph cards in the deck.
Input Format
The first line contains an integer 𝑡 that indicates the number of test cases. For each test case,
you are given a deck of graph cards. It begins with a line containing the number of graph cards
𝑛 > 0. Then, 𝑛 lines follow. Each line represents a graph card associated with a graph 𝐺 in
the following format:
𝑘 𝑢1 𝑣1 𝑢2 𝑣2 · · · 𝑢𝑘 𝑣𝑘
where 𝑘 > 0 denotes the number of nodes (also edges) in 𝐺 and for each 𝑖 ∈ [1, 𝑘] (𝑢𝑖
, 𝑣𝑖)
denotes an edge in 𝐺 that connects nodes 𝑢𝑖 and 𝑣𝑖
. Note that the identifiers of nodes are
integers in [1, 𝑘].
15

2020 ICPC Asia Taipei-Hsinchu Regional
Output Format
For each test case, output the number of distinct graph cards in the given deck on a line.
Technical Specification
• 0 < 𝑡 ≤ 30.
• 0 < 𝑛, 𝑘 ≤ 106
.
• For each test case, the numbers of nodes in the 𝑛 graph cards sum up to at most 106
.
Sample Input 1
1
2
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 1 4
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 2 4
Sample Output 1
1
Sample Input 2
2
2
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 1 4
5 1 2 2 3 3 1 2 4 2 5
3
9 1 2 2 5 5 7 7 6 6 3 3 1 2 4 7 9 9 8
9 1 4 4 2 2 3 3 5 5 7 7 6 6 4 7 8 8 9
9 1 2 2 5 5 4 4 1 4 7 7 8 8 6 8 9 5 3
Sample Output 2
2
2
16

[PDF](https://icpcarchive.github.io/Asia%20Pacific%20Contests/Taiwan/2020%20Asia%20Taipei-Hsinchu%20Regional%20Contest/problems.pdf)

# Graph Cards

Time limit: 4 seconds. Memory limit: 1024 megabytes.

## Problem Description

A deck of graph cards is placed on a table. Each card $\chi$ has an undirected simple graph $G_\chi$. The graph is connected and has the same number of vertices and edges. Different cards may have different numbers of vertices. An example is shown below.

![Graph cards](102835-G-figure-1.png)

Two cards are identical if and only if their graphs, $G_1=(V_1,E_1)$ and $G_2=(V_2,E_2)$, are isomorphic. This means there is a bijection $f$ between $V_1$ and $V_2$ such that, for every $x,y\in V_1$, $(x,y)\in E_1$ if and only if $(f(x),f(y))\in E_2$. Compute the number of distinct graph cards in the deck.

## Input Format

The first line contains an integer $t$, the number of test cases. Each test case describes a deck. Its first line contains the number of cards $n>0$. The next $n$ lines each describe the graph $G$ on one card, in the following format:

$$k\ u_1\ v_1\ u_2\ v_2\ \cdots\ u_k\ v_k$$

Here $k>0$ is the number of vertices and also the number of edges in $G$. For every $i\in[1,k]$, the pair $(u_i,v_i)$ is an edge joining vertices $u_i$ and $v_i$. Vertex identifiers are integers in $[1,k]$.

## Output Format

For each test case, output the number of distinct graph cards in the deck on one line.

## Technical Specification

- $0<t\le3$.
- $0<n,k\le10^6$.
- In each test case, the sum of the numbers of vertices over all $n$ cards is at most $10^6$.

## Sample 1

### Input

```text
1
2
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 1 4
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 2 4
```

### Output

```text
1
```

## Sample 2

### Input

```text
2
2
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 1 4
5 1 2 2 3 3 1 2 4 2 5
3
9 1 2 2 5 5 7 7 6 6 3 3 1 2 4 7 9 9 8
9 1 4 4 2 2 3 3 5 5 7 7 6 6 4 7 8 8 9
9 1 2 2 5 5 4 4 1 4 7 7 8 8 6 8 9 5 3
```

### Output

```text
2
2
```

translation.markdown:
# 图卡片

时间限制：4 秒。内存限制：1024 兆字节。

## 题目描述

桌上放着一叠图卡片。每张卡片 $\chi$ 上都有一张无向简单图 $G_\chi$，这张图连通，且顶点数与边数相同。不同卡片的顶点数可以不同。下图给出了一个例子。

![Graph cards](102835-G-figure-1.png)

两张卡片相同，当且仅当它们对应的图 $G_1=(V_1,E_1)$ 和 $G_2=(V_2,E_2)$ 同构。也就是说，$V_1$ 与 $V_2$ 之间存在一个双射 $f$，对于任意 $x,y\in V_1$，都有：$(x,y)\in E_1$ 当且仅当 $(f(x),f(y))\in E_2$。请计算这叠卡片中不同图卡片的数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$，表示测试用例数。每个测试用例描述一叠卡片：第一行给出卡片数 $n>0$，接下来的 $n$ 行，每行描述一张卡片上的图 $G$，格式如下：

$$k\ u_1\ v_1\ u_2\ v_2\ \cdots\ u_k\ v_k$$

其中，$k>0$ 表示图 $G$ 的顶点数，同时也是边数。对于每个 $i\in[1,k]$，$(u_i,v_i)$ 表示连接顶点 $u_i$ 和 $v_i$ 的一条边。顶点编号为 $[1,k]$ 内的整数。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一行，表示这叠卡片中不同图卡片的数量。

## 数据范围

- $0<t\le3$。
- $0<n,k\le10^6$。
- 每个测试用例中，所有 $n$ 张卡片的顶点数之和不超过 $10^6$。

## 样例 1

### 输入

```text
1
2
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 1 4
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 2 4
```

### 输出

```text
1
```

## 样例 2

### 输入

```text
2
2
4 1 2 2 3 3 1 1 4
5 1 2 2 3 3 1 2 4 2 5
3
9 1 2 2 5 5 7 7 6 6 3 3 1 2 4 7 9 9 8
9 1 4 4 2 2 3 3 5 5 7 7 6 6 4 7 8 8 9
9 1 2 2 5 5 4 4 1 4 7 7 8 8 6 8 9 5 3
```

### 输出

```text
2
2
```
